column1: # KB Layer-2 read-gate map (committable). Activates the pre_edit_write.sh KB DISCIPLINE READ GATE.
# Auto-seeded by apply-to-repo.sh (ensure_kb_paths_tsv); SAFE TO EDIT — never overwritten on re-deploy.
#   - prefix:        repo-relative path prefix; MUST end with "/" (council F-005/agy-gate-06: avoid greedy match).
#   - discipline:    short tag; per-session marker is kb_read_<discipline> (rule-specific when required_read set).
#   - required_read: OPTIONAL repo-relative governance note the AI MUST read before its first edit under
#                    that prefix this session (fail-LOUD if the file is missing).
# Lines starting with "#" and blank lines are ignored. THIS FILE SHIPS WITH ZERO ACTIVE ROWS — the gate
# stays PRESENT-BUT-EMPTY (session_start says so) until you add a real row, so it never falsely reports ACTIVE.
# Boundary (council PF item7): this file = per-repo gate map (what gets gated HERE).
#   <your-kb-repo>/projects/_map.yml = central repo->KB-project resolution ONLY; classification is NOT centralized.
# Example (uncomment + adapt to a real migration surface in THIS repo):
